title: Platea Team Knowledge Base
description: A wiki for the Platea team covering its products (Platea, Findit, Amplia MLS), infrastructure, databases, tooling, and the broader Forward (FWDPR) business ecosystem.

pages.title: Overview & Team Context
pages.description: Introduction to the Platea team, its parent organizations (Red Ventures, Forward/FWDPR), the products it operates, and how those products relate to each other within the broader ecosystem.

pages.title: Products & Domain Knowledge
pages.description: Detailed descriptions of the three core products — Platea (plateapr.com & El Pocillo newsletter), Findit (finditpr.com real estate marketplace), and Amplia MLS (Puerto Rico's first independent MLS) — including their missions, audiences, and market positioning.

pages.title: Infrastructure & Repositories
pages.description: AWS Lambda architecture for Findit and Amplia APIs, along with the GitHub repositories that power each product (backends, frontends, and supporting Lambdas). Benefits from a system architecture diagram showing domains, Lambdas, and repositories.

pages.title: Databases & Data Model
pages.description: Reference for the MySQL databases accessed via Metabase — Findit, Amplia MLS production, and Amplia MLS staging — including schemas, RESO Data Dictionary conventions, cross-MLS join guidelines, and how to look up Amplia listings on Zillow. An ER-style diagram of the key tables would help here.

pages.title: Clasificados Online Ingestion Pipeline
pages.description: End-to-end documentation of the automated scraping pipeline that ingests listings from clasificadosonline.com into Amplia MLS. Covers the Coordinator/Worker Lambda pair, SQS FIFO queue, and the staging-to-RESO data flow. Ideal for a data flow / architecture diagram.

pages.title: MCP Servers & Tooling
pages.description: Setup and configuration of the MCP servers used by the team — Metabase, Google Analytics, AWS Docs, and Sentry — plus the `uv`/`uvx` prerequisite. Useful for onboarding AI agents and new developers.

pages.title: Analytics & Event Tracking
pages.description: Google Analytics 4 event tracking for Platea, focusing on newsletter/email capture forms on plateapr.com — placements, the event funnel, and how the final snake_case implementation maps to the original PascalCase spec. A funnel/state diagram would clarify the user flow.
